about.title: What You Get Working With Me
paragraphs: Senior, part-time leadership that combines strategy with real execution. I've raised €550k, built teams, scaled products to 8M users, and delivered multiple 6-figure revenue businesses.
I can own the full funnel: product strategy, UX/UI, engineering, and acquisition. You get a single operator who can build the stack and make it convert, using AI to multiply delivery speed.
Best fit: B2C startups and small-to-mid businesses that need fractional leadership. I can step in part-time and move the business forward.

work.title: How I Work
paragraphs: Clear communication, fast execution, and measurable outcomes. That's the standard I bring to every engagement.
I'm comfortable leading teams and aligning stakeholders. I keep communication simple and practical, even when the tech is complex.
I've organized founder masterminds in Krakow where operators solved real problems together. It reinforced my bias toward execution over theory.
Public speaking is part of my background (Toastmasters, App Growth Summit in London with 300+ attendees, etc), but the real focus is delivering results for your business.

achievements.title: My Top 4 Achievements
achievements.subtitle: I deliver results, not just talk about them.

mentorist.title: Mentorist
mentorist.shortDescription: B2C product with 6-figure yearly revenue and €550k investment.
mentorist.fullStory:
Mentorist is my flagship B2C product. It reached 6-figure yearly revenue and raised €550k in investment.

The idea came from my frustration with book-summary apps. I built Mentorist to help people implement knowledge, not just read it. I worked on it solo for years, then raised funding and built a team.

The current version is rebuilt 100% by me—frontend, backend, UX/UI, visuals, and content—using AI tools extensively.

iqelite.title: IQElite
iqelite.fullStory:
I joined IQElite in Barcelona as a co-founder and CTO, focused on technology. After 1.5 years, I became CEO and took control of the company.

We had a 5-person team and were losing money. Within three months of me taking over, we broke even and stayed profitable for the next six years.

IQElite was a dating service built on psychometric tests (IQ, personality, EQ, love compatibility). We reached 8 million registered users. The platform later declined as Tinder and Bumble reshaped the market.

neurony.title: Neurony Szaleją
neurony.shortDescription: Performance marketing and conversion work that led to 6-figure yearly revenue.
neurony.fullStory:
Neurony Szaleją is a brand selling products for mothers of small children. In 2024, the business relied mostly on organic outreach.

I helped with performance marketing: creative guidance, Facebook Ads management, and later custom landing pages in React to improve conversion. We ran rapid A/B tests and optimized the funnel step by step.

The brand reached 6-figure yearly revenue and is expanding into other countries.

hackyeah.title: 1st Place - HackYeah 2025
hackyeah.shortDescription: Built a retirement simulation game in 24 hours; 1st place at HackYeah 2025.
hackyeah.fullStory:
I joined HackYeah 2025 in Krakow without a team. I met two people on-site, and we formed a three-person team.

We chose the "live run" category and built a retirement simulation game in 24 hours. The project won 1st place.

I used AI tools heavily to manage the workload and we produced around 14,000 lines of code during the hackathon.
